Preparing Thailand's education for OECD membership
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 10.30, committee meeting room CA 426, Floor 4, Parliament House, and online. The agenda is a study of how to prepare Thailand's education for membership of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), with King Prajadhipok's Institute and the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council invited to give information, and the work of the subcommittees. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.

Draft report on dual vocational education to raise high-performance vocational manpower
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 13.30 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 328, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider the draft study report on dual vocational education in public and private vocational institutions, to develop policy proposals that raise the quality of high-performance vocational manpower for employers and national development, with the working group and related agencies invited to take part, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.

Complaint about encroachment on headwater forest to grow ginger, and heavy-metal contamination in the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers
se: Meeting on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 14.00, committee room CA 429, 4th floor, Parliament House. According to the meeting notice, the agenda is the work of the subcommittees; the complaint about encroachment on headwater forest to grow ginger in Chai Prakan district, Chiang Mai, with the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation invited; and a study of how to deal with heavy-metal contamination in the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers in Chiang Rai and nearby provinces, with the Pollution Control Department, the Department of Health, the Department of Agriculture and the Customs Department invited to give information. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
